title: More optimistic results on AI and job markets
contentHtml: Here is a good Jon Hartley thread.  Here is the paper, with Jolevski, Melo, and Moore.  From Jon’s thread: “Generative AI adoption is widespread, but substantial aggregate labor-market disruption is not yet visible. Workers nevertheless perceive substantial displacement risk, especially when firsthand use reveals that AI can perform key tasks for their job.”  And again here is Alex”s post from yesterday.
